visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) High-angle drone shot showing a vast grey pebble beach meeting a turquoise sea with gentle waves. On the right, a lush green area with large trees houses a white and black camper van parked on gravel. Bright yellow text overlays the center. (2) Medium shot of a young woman wearing a beige t-shirt, black loose trousers, and a dark baseball cap. She stands in a gravel-covered campsite surrounded by leafy trees and folding camping chairs. She talks directly to the camera, using expressive hand gestures. (3) Transitions through various indoor facility shots. The woman points to a tall white double-door refrigerator under a dark wooden porch. She then walks toward a blue-painted building, showing a shower room with grey concrete walls and a bathroom with a white toilet and a blue-painted interior. (4) Close-ups of specific amenities including a silver washing machine and a rustic wooden counter area with cables and hairdryers. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from the open side of the shelter. (5) Wide shot of a quiet asphalt road lined with palm trees and utility poles. A two-story white building with a red vertical sign '旭海商店' is visible against green hills. The woman walks along the road, gesturing toward the building.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 最美的旭海 看海營地. [Subtitle]: 我們這次是來到旭海灣露營區. (2) [Subtitle]: 那我們這次搭的是面海區. (3) [Subtitle]: 那面海的話大概有6帳的空間. (4) [Subtitle]: 加整區的話就是14帳. (5) [Subtitle]: 那它的收費方式比較特別. (6) [Subtitle]: 只有一人車泊的話是收500塊錢. (7) [Subtitle]: 但是再加2-4人的話就是總共收1000塊. (8) [Subtitle]: 後面的區域的話收費方式也是一樣. (9) [Subtitle]: 我們來看看它的衛浴廁所和公共區吧. (10) [Subtitle]: 公共設備的話就是電冰箱. (11) [Subtitle]: 就是冷凍、冷藏都有. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後廁所是在這一邊. (13) [Subtitle]: 那它有4間淋浴間. (14) [Subtitle]: 給大家看一下淋浴間的樣子. (15) [Subtitle]: 就是乾淨而且很大. (16) [Subtitle]: 覺得就是帶小孩一起洗都不是問題. (17) [Subtitle]: 它的廁所的話就是一間坐式 兩間蹲式. (18) [Subtitle]: 那廁所的話空間就稍微狹小一點點. (19) [Subtitle]: 而且它還有附脫水機. (20) [Subtitle]: 這邊的話就是吹頭髮的區域. (21) [Subtitle]: 它有附吹風機. (22) [Subtitle]: 各位可以看到現在營地這邊啊. (23) [Subtitle]: 它其實有很多樹 但是它樹的高度比較低. (24) [Subtitle]: 你如果是掀頂的車友啊 可能就不能夠停得太靠近樹. (25) [Subtitle]: 因為頂可能會碰到樹. (26) [Subtitle]: 但是樹非常重要. (27) [Slogan]: 暑假讀完你保全. [Subtitle]: 對啊 現在樹的話 這個是能讓你保命的東西. (28) [Subtitle]: 對啊 我們在樹蔭底下超舒服的. (29) [Subtitle]: 營地對面往前走30秒的話 就有一個旭海商店. (30) [Subtitle]: 我跟老闆都非常熟了啦. (31) [Subtitle]: 他不知道我是誰啦. (32) [Subtitle]: 就我只是很熱情跟他打招呼 他還送我青菜呢.
